name: ZBD-05 amphibious IFV
protection: Aluminium hull optimised for high-speed water planing. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; frontal arc resists 12.7/14.5 mm; 7.62x54R damages optics, tyres/tracks and exposed gear, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear; all launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Long boat-shaped hull with a large folding bow plate (trim vane) for planing at sea
Six road wheels per side; tracks retract partially when planing
Small low turret mid-hull; ZTD-05 variant carries a 105 mm gun turret
PLA Marine Corps and amphibious combined-arms brigades; seen on Taiwan Strait exercises
